description: Shared capability for all platforms. Deliberately narrow: the app only WRITES to the clipboard (invite links, copied message text) so clipboard read access is not granted, and the app uses its own `open_external_url` command (which calls the opener plugin's Rust API and is therefore not ACL-gated), so no opener permission is granted at all. Filesystem access is limited to the six commands `$lib/app-data` actually calls, scoped to the preferences files: see the note on the fs block below for why the permission SETS must not be used here.
